segments.ja502:2.1: Ohāya maṃ ñātigaṇā, ekaṃ pāsavasaṃ gataṃ;
segments.ja502:3.1: Pateva patataṃ seṭṭha, natthi baddhe sahāyatā [sahāyakā (syā.)];
segments.ja502:3.3: Mā anīghāya hāpesi, kāmaṃ sumukha pakkama.
segments.ja502:4.3: Jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ vā me, tayā saddhiṃ bhavissati.
segments.ja502:5.1: Etadariyassa kalyāṇaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ sumukha bhāsasi;
segments.ja502:6.1: Apadena padaṃ yāti, antalikkhacaro [antalikkhe caro (sī. pī.)] dijo;
segments.ja502:6.3: Ārā pāsaṃ na bujjhi tvaṃ, haṃsānaṃ pavaruttama [pavaruttamo (ka. sī. pī.)].
segments.ja502:7.3: Atha jālañca pāsañca, āsajjāpi na bujjhati.
segments.ja502:8.3: Harittaca hemavaṇṇa, tvaññeva [tvañca taṃ (sī.), tvañca (pī.)] avahiyyasi.
segments.ja502:9.1: Ete bhutvā ca pitvā ca, pakkamanti vihaṅgamā;
segments.ja502:10.1: Kinnu tyāyaṃ [tāyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] dijo hoti, mutto baddhaṃ upāsasi;
segments.ja502:10.3: Ohāya sakuṇā yanti, kiṃ eko avahiyyasi.
segments.ja502:11.1: Rājā me so dijo mitto, sakhā pāṇasamo ca me;
segments.ja502:11.3: Neva naṃ vijahissāmi, yāva kālassa pariyāyaṃ.
segments.ja502:12.1: Yo ca tvaṃ sakhino hetu, pāṇaṃ cajitumicchasi;
segments.ja502:12.3: So te sahāyaṃ muñcāmi, hotu rājā tavānugo.
segments.ja502:13.1: Evaṃ luddaka nandassu, saha sabbehi ñātibhi;
segments.ja502:14.1: Kaccinnu bhoto kusalaṃ, kacci bhoto anāmayaṃ;
segments.ja502:15.1: Kusalañceva me haṃsa, atho haṃsa anāmayaṃ;
segments.ja502:16.1: Kacci bhoto amaccesu, doso koci na vijjati;
segments.ja502:16.3: Kacci ārā amittā te, chāyā dakkhiṇatoriva.
segments.ja502:17.1: Athopi me amaccesu, doso koci na vijjati;
segments.ja502:17.3: Atho ārā amittā me, chāyā dakkhiṇatoriva.
segments.ja502:18.1: Kacci te sādisī bhariyā, assavā piyabhāṇinī;
segments.ja502:19.1: Atho me sādisī bhariyā, assavā piyabhāṇinī;
segments.ja502:20.1: Kacci te bahavo puttā, sujātā raṭṭhavaḍḍhana;
segments.ja502:21.1: Satameko ca me puttā, dhataraṭṭha mayā sutā;
segments.ja502:21.3: Tesaṃ tvaṃ kiccamakkhāhi, nāvarujjhanti [nāvarajjhanti (ka. sī. pī.)] te vaco.
segments.ja502:22.1: Upapannopi ce hoti, jātiyā vinayena vā;
segments.ja502:22.3: Atha pacchā kurute yogaṃ, kicche [kicce (sī. syā. pī.)] āpāsu [āvāsu (syā.), āpadāsu (ka.)] sīdati.
segments.ja502:24.1: Asāre sārayogaññū, matiṃ na tveva vindati;
segments.ja502:25.1: Hīnajaccopi ce hoti, uṭṭhātā dhitimā naro;
segments.ja502:26.1: Etaṃ me upamaṃ katvā, putte vijjāsu vācaya [ṭhāpasa (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja502:26.3: Saṃvirūḷhetha medhāvī, khette bījaṃva [khettabījaṃva (sī. pī.)] vuṭṭhiyāti.
